description: This header file declares utility functions for testing gradient computations within TensorFlow's C++ API. Specifically, it provides a function to call the gradient function associated with a given operation, adding gradient operations to a computation graph, and outputs the gradients of inputs.
external_methods: absl::Status CallGradFunction(const Scope&, const Operation&, const std::vector<Output>&, std::vector<Output>*)

methods.name: CallGradFunction
methods.description: Calls the registered gradient function for a specified operation, appending the corresponding gradient operations to the provided scope. It outputs the gradients corresponding to each input of the operation.
